text: You're at a restaurant, hungry and scanning the menu. All you want is a delicious meal, something satisfying and perfectly prepared.
Then your eyes land on it: the 'Daily Special.' It sounds unique, intriguing, and often feels like a secret, exclusive offer just for you.
But have you ever paused to wonder why almost every restaurant has these 'specials'? Is it truly a limited-time culinary masterpiece, or something else?
The invisible system at play is inventory management. Chefs use specials to utilize ingredients that are perishable, nearing their best-by date, or simply overstocked.
They also smooth demand, guiding you towards dishes that efficiently use current stock, ensuring freshness and minimizing waste, all while maximizing profit.
So, the next time you order a special, you'll see beyond the tempting description. You'll recognize a clever, strategic system ensuring every plate serves a purpose.
